title: Mudcovered Letter (rogue)
wikitext:
The '''Mudcovered Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Black Letter|race=Goblin|class=rogue}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
<name>, rumours spread of a particularly agile goblin doing menial tasks in the coalpits. If you ask me, you're destined for more.

A rogue has many abilities that suit us goblins - our subtlety, nimble fingers and general willingness to overlook morals are perfect requisites. If you are interested in catching a few new tricks on how to get money, then I'll be happy to oblige - with the right payment, ofcourse.

Leyli Quicktongue, Rogue Trainer.
}}

==Trivia==
* Although the quest associated with the letter is named "Black Letter", it instead shares a name with [[Mudcovered Letter (hunter)|its hunter equivalent]].

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.17.1|note=Added, replaces [[Ooze-covered Letter]].}}
